title: Fractions practice
description: Five questions on halves, quarters and adding fractions. Get 4 of the last 5 right.

questions.question: A cake is cut into 4 equal pieces. Tendai eats 1 piece. What fraction of the cake did he eat?
questions.hint: The cake has 4 equal pieces and he ate 1 of them.

questions.question: How many quarters make one whole?
questions.hint: Think of a cake cut into quarters.

questions.question: Which fraction is the same as one half?
questions.hint: Cut each half into two pieces.

questions.question: What is 1/4 + 2/4?
questions.hint: The pieces are the same size, so add the tops: 1 + 2.

questions.question: Which fractions are bigger than one half? Choose all that are right.
